_readme: Site-wide settings. Edit values here and the whole site updates. Fields starting with an underscore are notes for maintainers and are ignored by the site.
name: ANU Catholic Society
tagline: Faith and friendship at the heart of Australia's national university.
description: The home of Catholic students at ANU: weekly Mass, prayer, formation, friendship and service, gathered around the St John the Evangelist Chapel on Daley Road.
_description: Kept near 110-120 characters where used for social previews so link previews do not truncate.
socialDescription: Catholic life at ANU: weekly Mass, prayer, formation and friendship at the St John the Evangelist Chapel, Daley Road.

authorCredit._note: Small out-of-the-way credit in the footer. The prominent credit is the executive credit below.
authorCredit.name: Peter Woodhead (Secretary)

primaryLocation.name: St John the Evangelist Chapel
primaryLocation.campusNote: On ANU campus, next to John XXIII College on Daley Road.

links._note: External links. Update the linktree/instagram/rubric URLs here only - every button on the site reads from this block.

_johnsHistoryBook: Paste the URL of the John XXIII College history book page here when known and it will appear on the About page. Leave empty to hide the link.

contactForm._note: Static sites cannot receive form posts by themselves. Create a free form at https://formspree.io, then paste its endpoint here (looks like https://formspree.io/f/abcdwxyz). While this is empty the contact page automatically falls back to an email link - nothing breaks.

affiliations: The ANU Catholic Society is a student society affiliated with the ANU Students' Association. Sacraments are celebrated by our chaplaincy and local parishes of the Archdiocese of Canberra and Goulburn; the Society does not administer parish schedules.
emergencyNote: This website and our inboxes are not monitored around the clock and are not an emergency or counselling service. In an emergency call 000. ANU Wellbeing support: 1300 050 327. Lifeline: 13 11 14.
